paper_title: Toward Better Depth Lower Bounds: The XOR-KRW Conjecture
statement: 1. Is there a generic ways to convert lower bounds for classical communication into half-duplex and partially half-duplex? 2. Is there another proof of the results from this paper, that doesn’t rely on non-classical models?
context: Open questions 1. Is there a generic ways to convert lower bounds for classical communication into half-duplex and partially half-duplex? 2. Is there another proof of the results from this paper, that doesn’t rely on non-classical models? 3. Prove lower bound of 2n − o(n) for Un ⊞ MUXn in classical, partially half-duplex or half-duplex model. 4. Prove that for some f, g : Bn → Bn , CC(KWf ⊞g ) ≥ (1 + ϵ)n.
